data.name: label2.Text
data.value: The Diploma in Office Management Technology with Specialization in Legal Office Management (DOMT-LOM) is a three-year ladderized program designed to develop students’ 21st century skills in the field of office management, administration, and technology. The DOMT curriculum was methodically designed to integrate courses in office and business management and technology – with emphasis in legal office management and transcription. The program aims to develop students’ skills and proficiencies in document management and office administration to meet the rising demand for competent, technopreneurship-inclined and highly skilled individuals and professionals that can assume clerical, mid, and executive-level positions in diverse businesses and industries.

data.name: label4.Text
data.value: Career opportunities for graduates of DOMT-LOM typically include administrative roles within legal firms, government agencies, corporate legal departments, or non-profit organizations. Graduates can work as legal administrative assistants, legal secretaries, or paralegals, providing support in drafting legal documents, managing case files, scheduling appointments, and assisting with research tasks. They may also find opportunities in records management, document control, and office coordination specific to legal environments. Additionally, graduates can pursue roles in compliance, contract management, or legal support services, utilizing their specialized knowledge in legal office procedures and technology. These positions require strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency in legal terminology and documentation processes.
